localCampaign.emailSubject: Web Developer | 3+ Years Experience | Immediate Joiner
localCampaign.emailBody:
Hello Sir/Ma’am,

I hope you’re doing well.

My name is Dhananjay Shahane, and I’m a web developer & AI developer with 3 years and 2 months of professional experience in web, mobile, and AI application development.

I came across your company through Google Business Profile and wanted to check if you currently have any full-time, freelance, or contract developer opportunities that match my skills and experience.

Technical Skills:

* Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js, Next.js, React Router, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap
* Backend: Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs
* Mobile Development: Flutter, Dart
* Database: PostgreSQL
* AI & LLM: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Ollama, MCP
* Vibe Coding & AI Development: OpenAI, Antigravity, Claude Code
* State Management: Redux, Riverpod
* Tools & Technologies: Git, GitHub, Vite, Firebase, Redis, Docker
* UI/UX & Animation: Responsive Design, GSAP, Framer Motion, React Icons
* Deployment & Server: Nginx, Linux, PM2, Vercel
* Other: API Integration, Payment Gateway Integration, Authentication, Real-time Features, Dashboard Development

Professional Details:

* Total Experience: 3 years 2 months
* Current Salary: ₹28,000/month
* Expected Salary: ₹32,000/month
* Availability: Immediate Joiner
* Reason for Job Change: Looking for better career growth, challenging projects, opportunities to work with modern technologies, and a role where I can contribute my technical skills to meaningful projects.

Portfolio: https://dhananjay-shahane.vercel.app
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/dhananjay-shahane/
GitHub: https://github.com/dhananjay-shahane
Contact: +91 7350736478

I would be happy to discuss my experience, technical skills, and how I can contribute to your team or projects.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Dhananjay Shahane
Full Stack & AI Developer
